name: Drive Kids Away
steps: Tap the trench coat to find a child hiding inside. Check behind the pillow to find another child.
Open the bed drawers and reveal a hidden child.
Move the books on the bookshelf to uncover a child.
Tap the wall painting to find a child behind it.
Open the bathroom door and catch the child hiding there.
Check the water dispenser compartment for a hidden child.
Tap the cactus to reveal a child in disguise.
Tap the ceiling lamp to find a child hanging above.
Pull off the pink blanket to reveal the eldest son in disguise.
